response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced generalist (15+ years) with strong distributed-systems, event-driven, and low-latency engineering instincts, but the core requirement — senior-level C++/STL development — is essentially absent. C++ appears only in a 7-month role at National Instruments (2014–2015) and a university thesis project; the last decade is TypeScript/Node.js, D, and web/cloud work. There is also no evidence of industrial automation domain exposure, IEC 62443/SDL security practice, MQTT or OPC UA/Modbus protocols, UML/architecture documentation deliverables, or Azure. The role also implies people leadership and mentoring on secure coding standards, which is not demonstrated in a security context. Redirecting to a backend/platform or full-stack senior role would be a much better match.
strengths: Deep experience with high-throughput, low-latency, event-driven distributed systems
Strong engineering craft: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, open-source library authorship
Proven mentoring and technical communication via workshops, courses, and conference talks
concerns: C++/STL experience is minimal and over a decade stale
No industrial automation, IoT protocol (MQTT/OPC UA/Modbus), or IEC 62443/SDL background
No Azure cloud exposure and no evidence of formal architecture/UML documentation work

key_factors.factor: Industrial automation and IEC 62443 security domain gap
